newsitem.title: UK: National Grid could float Energis-paper.
newsitem.headline: National Grid could float Energis-paper.

text.p: Britain's electricity transmission network National Grid Group Plc is considering whether to float off its telecommunications subsidiary Energis in a move which could raise 800 million pounds ($1.3 billion), the Observer newspaper said.
National Grid said last year it was hoping to sell a large stake in Energis to an international communications company but failed to strike a deal.
A National Grid spokesman told the newspaper that the network's strategy for Energis had changed but said it would want to retain a stake in the subsidiary.
Energis said in January that National Grid might sell a stake in the company later in the year.
